lookahead.fixture: Exploratory synthetic witness chosen in development. Cores are disabled to isolate mass redistribution.
lookahead.oracleProtocol: Transfer 16-cell roof patches among four roof positions. The score lookahead compares up to two exchanges, all checked by the actual geometry projector at identical FAR.
lookahead.policyProtocol: Free masks on the same initial state, up to two decisions. Finish is legal. No action template is supplied.

decoderGate.FARGuard: validation FAR success must equal or exceed legacy

plan.reporting: Show all model seeds, all attempts, per-site and pooled reference quality and FAR success. Greedy uses the same decoder, site split and evaluation seeds.
plan.selection: Validation FAR success, then common reference quality; ties favor fixed, annealed, scalar in that order. Confirm this arm and imitation at the frozen final episode budget.

annealed.note: All failures retained. Confidence intervals resample model seeds, not correlated episodes. Small runs are pipeline checks, not convergence evidence.
